description: This file defines various executor-level metrics for Apache Spark, including memory usage, garbage collection, and process metrics, using traits, case objects, and external Java management interfaces.

classes.name: ExecutorMetricType
classes.description: Sealed trait for executor metrics, providing methods to retrieve metric values and names.

classes.name: SingleValueExecutorMetricType
classes.description: Trait for metrics with a single value, extending ExecutorMetricType.

classes.name: MemoryManagerExecutorMetricType
classes.description: Abstract class for metrics based on MemoryManager functions.

classes.name: MBeanExecutorMetricType
classes.description: Abstract class for metrics retrieved via JMX MBeans.

classes.name: JVMHeapMemory
classes.description: Represents JVM heap memory usage metric.

classes.name: JVMOffHeapMemory
classes.description: Represents JVM off-heap memory usage metric.

classes.name: ProcessTreeMetrics
classes.description: Metrics related to process memory usage, including JVM, Python, and other process types.

classes.name: GarbageCollectionMetrics
classes.description: Metrics related to JVM garbage collection, including counts and times for different GC types.

methods.name: getMetricValues
methods.description: Method to retrieve an array of metric values for a given MemoryManager.

methods.name: names
methods.description: Method returning a sequence of metric names.

methods.name: getMetricValue
methods.description: Method to retrieve a single metric value from MemoryManager.
